# Charts

A bar chart:

```chart
{
  "type": "bar",
  "title": "Revenue",
  "data": [
    {
      "category": "Q1",
      "value": 100
    },
    {
      "category": "Q2",
      "value": 150
    }
  ],
  "config": {
    "xLabel": "",
    "yLabel": "",
    "showGrid": true,
    "showLegend": false,
    "colorScheme": "neutral"
  }
}
```
